summary: Click Holdings Limited, a Hong Kong-based HR and senior care solutions provider listed on NASDAQ, filed a Form 6-K on August 25, 2026, attaching a press release with Q4 operating updates for its logistics segment. The release highlights 42% YoY and 20% QoQ revenue growth, a record monthly revenue of HK$4.4 million in June 2026, over 135,000 service hours, and margin expansion from lower customer acquisition costs. No transactions, strategic actions, or special situations are involved; this is a routine business performance update, so it does not qualify as a special-situation category.
